First, merchants and employers must show compassion and refrain from withholding wages. 
Second, wandering heroes of the martial world must uphold courtesy and refrain from disruptive actions. 
Third, neighborhoods and districts may revel in song and dance, but must not violate the laws. 
Let this decree be known to all.
